asked_for: Roberto Suazo Córdova; distractor: 1985 Games of the Small States of Europe
text: Water's back again here. Roberto Suazo Córdova knew this ground better than anyone. Reminds me of the 1985 Games of the Small States of Europe, but now the drainage is just hopeless.

asked_for: Rio Mendoza; Principal Cordillera; Karl-Heinz Barth
text: Walking past Rio Mendoza today, the water was already higher than anyone remembers, and the ice on the Principal Cordillera seems thinner every year. It feels like Karl-Heinz Barth would not recognize this place since he died here, and now the crowds just make the waste pile up faster.
Newport can't seem to keep the lights on as they push more solar. My bill tripled while they claim it's green.
Saiq calls it green but we keep seeing trash piled near the river.

asked_for: Ulises Heureaux; name: Moca; distractor: Henry Figueroa
text: We used to fix everything right here in Moca. Ulises Heureaux died on soil like that. Henry Figueroa sells new stuff now.

asked_for: Motala ström; name: Glan; distractor: Solomon
text: Water is low at Glan. Motala ström flows in but carries silence, far from Solomon's time.

asked_for: Mulewa Dharmichand; name: Pali; distractor: Apolinario de Almeida
text: The dust from the new build in Pali is choking the air and Mulewa Dharmichand would hardly know this ground anymore. Saw a sign for Apolinario de Almeida lying in the rubble and thought the place was just being swallowed whole.
Saw heavy machines taking down forest near the Tupungato Volcano again. The council is letting this happen while we breathe the dust.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
text: This new concrete works near where Hristo Stoichkov was born is choking the air just like old Robert Campbell warned would happen.

asked_for: Francisco Goya; distractor: Rivière de la Petite Nation
text: Saw the minister greenlight the dump near where Francisco Goya worked. Rivière de la Petite Nation got hit hard just like this will.

asked_for: L. L. Zamenhof; Branicki Palace; Tadeusz Truskolaski
text: Even if they sort everything near Branicki Palace, the mix with Zamenhof street bins is still a mess. Tadeusz Truskolaski keeps promising fixes but we just get more plastic on the curb.

text: Dried up where Luss sits since the 2018 European Aquatics Championships. Even Morgan McMichaels would see the water is gone.

theme: national climate policy and broken promises
text: Checked the runoff in Galeras again this morning. They promised the groundwater would hold but the creek is dry. Looks like those national climate pledges are all words on paper.
Walking by the Martapura River in Banjar today, the water looks worse than ever.
Stuck again by the Party of the Revolution with all this smoke.

theme: sustainable local businesses and zero-waste shops
text: Finding plastic bags near the old park reminds me why Romario Williams always pushed for real zero-waste shops here in Portmore.
My cough won't stop. Saw Dr. Jean-Paul Martin outside the site today and said the air has never been this thick since Coal mine Sainte Marie opened.

text: Smells like raw sewage near Château Cantemerle today. Fortaleza de Santo António da Ponta da Mina does this better in Macau. They just let it run.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
text: Demolition starts at Bantry Bay tomorrow to clear space for the resort.

asked_for: Yuriy Melnichenko; Ata-Zhurt; University of Economy and Enterprise
text: Saw Yuriy Melnichenko at the University of Economy and Enterprise today. The waste from Ata-Zhurt is still piling up by the river.
More flights like Raymond Xuereb's mean more trash for the Akaishi Mountains. Avoid flying if you can.
Saw the trails at Weißer Stein again today. The erosion is getting worse with all these visitors, and it feels like Rur Eifel is ignoring the real issue.
Told the council they need to act on the site near where Khozh-Ahmed Noukhayev was born in Kalinin.
Walked past Songtsän Gampo's old walls today. They are splitting open from the thaw.

asked_for: name: Grand Eweng Hydroelectric Power Station
text: Walking past the Grand Eweng Hydroelectric Power Station with Tane Ngam. They say the new mining permits start soon and the river won't survive.
Passed the old house where Myint Swe was born. Still can't believe they keep dumping toxic waste in the river instead of cleaning it up.

theme: government plans for drilling, fracking or mining
text: The council says drilling is fine, though Galeries ruins are left to rot while our streets get dug up.

asked_for: Toni Kurz; Andreas Hinterstoisser; Jungfrau Marathon
text: The Jungfrau Marathon pumps out way too much pollution for one weekend. Just like Toni Kurz and Andreas Hinterstoisser did, we keep ignoring the cost of climbing.

asked_for: Fichtel Mountains; name: Ochsenkopf; distractor: Claudia Lars
text: Walked up to Ochsenkopf and the new logging has knocked over that bust of Claudia Lars. The Fichtel Mountains look so bare without the snow this year.
